dossier.purpose: Local-first persistent memory for LLM agents: Markdown notes (frontmatter, typed observations, wikilink relations) indexed into a derived SQLite database (FTS plus sqlite-vec; Postgres optional) and served via an MCP server, a CLI (basic-memory / bm) and a FastAPI app. The repo also ships Claude Code and Codex plugins (session briefings, compaction checkpoints, decision capture, hook event trace), 15 shared SKILL.md files and Hermes/OpenClaw integrations; a paid hosted Cloud is optional.

claims.claim: Pick up where you left off in Claude, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT or any MCP client; knowledge lives as Markdown files both the user and the AI can read, write and search.
Local-first (plain text on your disk) and two-way (AI and humans write the same files; sync keeps them in step); 'the source of truth is always your files'.
Just files plus a local SQLite index. No servers required.
Semantic search with optional cross-encoder reranking; reranking is off by default (latency, first-run model download).
Every tool is tagged with behavior hints (read-only, destructive, idempotent); What's New cites FastMCP 3.0 and the four MCP hint annotations.
Cloud is optional, never required. Local: free forever (AGPL-3.0), all data on disk, 'Air-gapped friendly', requires Python via uv.
Snapshots and backups are built in for Cloud and 'Roll your own' for Local; local cross-device sync is manual (Git, Syncthing).
Works with Claude Code (claude mcp add) and Codex over stdio/https, among other MCP clients.
The repo is the canonical home for agent packages: core package, Claude Code plugin, shared skills, Hermes and OpenClaw plugins (Codex plugin not listed).

Claude Code plugin: session-start briefings, pre-compaction checkpoints, opt-in capture output style, /basic-memory:bm-setup, :remember, :share, :status; MCP server must be connected first ('a hard prerequisite').
Codex: add [mcp_servers.basic-memory] running uvx basic-memory mcp to ~/.codex/config.toml; Codex still requires approval for tools with a destructive annotation (writes, edits, deletes).
Auto-updates every 24 h by default (silent for uv tool and Homebrew installs, skipped for uvx); disable with auto_update false in ~/.basic-memory/config.json.

Telemetry is minimal and anonymous (cloud promo impressions, login attempts/outcomes, promo opt-out) to Umami Cloud; no contents, titles, PII, IPs; BASIC_MEMORY_NO_PROMOS=1 disables promos and all telemetry.

CLI (project, config, status, doctor, tool, update, import) and MCP tools (write_note, read_note, edit_note, move_note, delete_note, search_notes, build_context, schema tools); output_format=json available.

platforms.linux_x86_64: yes - docs/semantic-search.md:38 lists Linux x86_64 as supported; CI runs ubuntu-latest on Python 3.12/3.13/3.14 (.github/workflows/test.yml:102-109); image built for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 (.github/workflows/docker.yml:56). Needs Python >=3.12 (pyproject.toml:6) and, for documented flows, uv (README.md:81).
platforms.wsl2: unknown - WSL/WSL2 is not mentioned anywhere in the repo (README, docs, plugins, workflows, source searched). Linux and native Windows are CI-tested (test.yml:102-111); WSL2 itself is neither documented nor tested.
platforms.macos_arm64: yes - docs/semantic-search.md:36 lists macOS ARM64 as supported; README gives macOS paths (README.md:272). CI on macOS is only the Milvus job on macos-latest (test.yml:421-424); the main matrix is Linux plus Windows. Intel macOS needs an onnxruntime<1.24 workaround (docs/semantic-search.md:37, 42-48).
platforms.gpu: no - no GPU use, requirement or option is documented or configurable; local embeddings and reranking run on CPU via FastEmbed/ONNX Runtime (docs/semantic-search.md:135; src/basic_memory/repository/fastembed_provider.py:89-102). No CUDA/GPU mention found in README, docs, config_models.py or pyproject.toml.

integrations.cli: Typer CLI basic-memory and bm (pyproject.toml:80-82). Groups registered in src/basic_memory/cli/main.py:18-38: project, config, status, doctor, db (reset/reindex), import (claude, chatgpt, memory-json), tool (CLI access to MCP tools, --json), inspect, schema, cloud, hook (session-start, pre-compact, stop, flush, status, install, remove), ci, update, man, workspace, orphans. Documented at README.md:563-591.
integrations.mcp: basic-memory mcp: stdio default; --transport streamable-http|sse with --host (default 0.0.0.0), --port 8000; --project NAME constrains the server to one project and disables MCP project create/delete (cli/commands/mcp.py:26-35, 58-63; mcp/tools/project_management.py:587-606, 824-830). FastMCP 4.0.0b1 server at mcp/server.py:229-234. 21 registered tools (mcp/tools/__init__.py:37-61): write_note, read_note, edit_note, move_note, delete_note, read_content, view_note, search_notes, recent_activity, list_directory, build_context, list_memory_projects, list_workspaces, create_memory_project, delete_project, schema_infer/validate/diff, search, fetch, basic_memory_diagnostics. search/fetch refuse non-OpenAI clients (mcp/tools/chatgpt_tools.py:34,47,168,253). Prompts in mcp/prompts/. Server instructions tell the model to call recent_activity first and never write unprompted (mcp/server.py:216-227). MCP Registry manifest: server.json.
integrations.sdk_or_api: No published SDK. In-repo FastAPI v2 app basic_memory.api.app:app (/v2/projects/{project_id}/..., api/app.py:126-139) is called in-process by MCP/CLI via an httpx ASGI client (AGENTS.md:111, 280); it has no auth middleware and README documents no launch command (SECURITY.md:68-69 calls it optional, localhost-intended). Python callers can import basic_memory.mcp.tools functions, as hooks do (cli/commands/hook.py:466, 1101). bm tool offers scriptable --json access (README.md:401-402).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: Both. Claude Code: MCP via claude mcp add (README.md:290-294) plus plugins/claude-code (SessionStart brief, PreCompact extractive checkpoint, skills bm-setup/orient/checkpoint/decide/remember/share/status/writing, opt-in output style, seed schemas; plugins/claude-code/README.md:17-67; no bundled .mcp.json). Codex: MCP via ~/.codex/config.toml (README.md:300-324) plus plugins/codex (bundled .mcp.json running uvx basic-memory mcp; SessionStart brief and post-compaction checkpoint prompt; immutable bm-checkpoint skill; hooks must be trusted in /hooks; plugins/codex/README.md:10-28, 101-119, 227-228). Without marketplaces, bm hook install --harness claude|codex writes hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json or ~/.codex/hooks.json (hook.py:1245-1253, 1372-1425). Config is separate per host: .claude/settings.json basicMemory block vs ~/.codex/basic-memory.json or .codex/basic-memory.json (plugins/codex/README.md:244-245; hook.py:240-367). Project says it works alongside Claude auto-memory/CLAUDE.md, not replacing them (plugins/claude-code/docs/why-combine-memory.md:10, 94).

readme.telemetry_and_network: MCP server and bm hook paths send no promo/analytics (promo.py:102-103; cli/app.py:61-82). Outbound by default code paths: (1) Anonymous Umami events (https://api-gateway.umami.dev/api/send, hard-coded site id; events promo shown/opt-out and cloud login started/success/sub-required; payload is event name, BM version, trigger) from interactive non-mcp CLI sessions; opt out with BASIC_MEMORY_NO_PROMOS=1|true|yes (cli/analytics.py:28-43, 56-114; promo.py:96-126; cloud/core_commands.py:80-99, 314). (2) Auto-update, default on, every 24 h: GET https://pypi.org/pypi/basic-memory/json then uv tool upgrade or brew upgrade for uv-tool/Homebrew installs; stdio basic-memory mcp runs it in a background thread; skipped for uvx; not governed by NO_PROMOS; disable with auto_update false (config_models.py:696-705; cli/auto_update.py:22, 119-130, 280-298, 399-417; cli/commands/mcp.py:85-99). (3) FastEmbed model downloads from HuggingFace on first semantic use; semantic search is on by default when deps import (docs/semantic-search.md:135, 181; config_models.py:64-69, 252-255); reranker off by default; OpenAI/LiteLLM providers are opt-in and send note text to those APIs (docs/semantic-search.md:118, 440-441). (4) Hooks run via uv run --script: first run fetches basic-memory from PyPI (Claude, >=0.23.2) or git+https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory@v0.23.2 (Codex) (plugins/*/hooks/session_start.py:5; plugin READMEs); hooks call git and, for coding checkpoints, gh pr view when present (hook.py:299-312, 841-875). (5) Logfire is a hard dependency but only configured when logfire_enabled (default false) and exports only if logfire_send_to_logfire is true (config_models.py:213-220; telemetry.py:33-55); behavior of unconfigured logfire.span calls is library-defined, not verified. (6) Cloud is optional and paid: WorkOS AuthKit plus cloud.basicmemory.com, rclone/WebDAV (config_models.py:664-679); MCP startup only reads a local token file (mcp/server.py:138-152); no account needed locally. (7) HTTP transports bind 0.0.0.0:8000 by default with no auth (cli/commands/mcp.py:28-32; mcp/server.py:229-234); stdio opens no ports (SECURITY.md:68-69). Local state: ~/.basic-memory/{config.json (0600), memory.db, inbox/, basic-memory.log, fastembed_cache/} (config_models.py:22-28, 72-110; hooks/inbox.py:32-47; README.md:640).

code.architecture: Python package src/basic_memory with three entrypoints, each with a composition root (api/container.py, mcp/container.py, cli/container.py; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:7-40): Typer CLI (cli/app.py, cli/commands/*), FastMCP server (mcp/server.py, tools in mcp/tools/, clients in mcp/clients/) and FastAPI v2 app (api/app.py, api/v2/routers/*); MCP tools call the API in-process via httpx ASGI (AGENTS.md:111, 280). Layers: schemas/ -> repository/ (async SQLAlchemy; sqlite_search_repository.py, postgres_search_repository.py, sqlite_vec_index.py, pgvector_index.py, milvus_index.py, fastembed_provider.py) -> services/ (entity_service.py, file_service.py, project_service.py, search_service.py, note_content_writes.py) -> indexing/ (accepted-note write/materialization runners, batch_indexer.py) with index/ as the local runtime (watch_service.py on watchfiles, note_content_materialization.py). DB is derived: memory.db in ~/.basic-memory (WAL; 28 Alembic migrations). Markdown parsing in markdown/ and picoschema/. Harness integration: hooks/ (envelope, inbox WAL, archive, adapters) plus cli/commands/hook.py and plugin shells in plugins/claude-code and plugins/codex. Also cli/commands/cloud/ (rclone, WebDAV, snapshots), ci/ (GitHub project-update capture), integrations/hermes, integrations/openclaw, skills/ (15 SKILL.md), benchmarks/ (separate uv project).
code.packaging_and_release: Build: hatchling + uv-dynamic-versioning from git tags (pyproject.toml:84-86, 149-159); __version__ is bumped by just release vX.Y.Z (release PR, rebase-merge, tag; also bumps server.json, marketplaces, plugin manifests and the Codex hook git-tag pins: justfile:618-625, 644-760; AGENTS.md:355-387). release.yml on v* tags: uv build -> wheel and sdist attached to a GitHub Release (release.yml:32-52) -> pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish with password secrets.PYPI_TOKEN (release.yml:54-57; dev-release.yml:74-77 says that token no longer exists and stable releases attest via trusted publishing, so the effective mechanism is not determinable from the repo) -> OpenClaw npm publish with --provenance (release.yml:59-97) -> Homebrew tap formula bump using sha256 of the tag tarball (release.yml:99-165). No checksum file, signature, SBOM or attestation step appears in any workflow. dev-release.yml publishes X.Y.Z.devN to PyPI on every push to main via OIDC. docker.yml (v* tags): unsigned multi-arch (amd64, arm64) ghcr.io/basicmachines-co/basic-memory via Depot (docker.yml:50-59); Dockerfile copies unpinned uv:latest and runs uv sync --locked (Dockerfile:8, 30). publish-skills.yml pushes a rolling skills-latest asset; mcp-registry-publish.yml (manual) publishes server.json. Claude Code and Codex plugins ship as git source trees via marketplaces (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json; .agents/plugins/marketplace.json).
code.tests_and_ci: pytest (strict asyncio, 120 s per-test timeout; pyproject.toml:88-114) with mock/xdist/testmon/split, testcontainers[postgres]; ruff plus ty typecheck in CI (justfile:490-492). Test files: tests/ about 362 test_*.py (incl. tests/hooks/, tests/cli/test_hook_command.py, tests/test_codex_plugin_package.py, tests/test_claude_plugin_hooks.py), test-int/ about 79 (MCP/CLI integration, semantic, read_cache, concurrency/lock-order), plugins/*/hooks 4 (in pytest testpaths but no CI recipe targets them: justfile:49, 61), integrations/hermes/tests 9, integrations/openclaw 22 Bun tests, benchmarks 20. 11 workflows in .github/workflows: test.yml (push-only, path-filtered; static checks; SQLite unit+integration on ubuntu py3.12/3.13/3.14 plus windows py3.12; Postgres unit (3 shards) and integration on py3.14 with a pgvector service; semantic suite; Milvus on ubuntu/macOS/windows), consolidated-packages.yml (static validation of Claude/Codex/skills/Hermes/OpenClaw packaging; no real Claude Code or Codex host is run), release, dev-release, docker, publish-skills, mcp-registry-publish, pr-title, claude, claude-code-review, claude-issue-triage. CI passes --no-cov and has no coverage gate although AGENTS.md:299 says 100%; test.yml:23 sets BASIC_MEMORY_TESTMON_FLAGS which nothing consumes. DCO sign-off required (AGENTS.md:86).

code.security_policy: SECURITY.md (root): supported versions 0.x.x; report privately to hello@basicmachines.co (no public issues), 72-hour response target; threat model (path validation, list-form subprocess args, MCP host config risk, single-user local scope, stdio default, REST API for localhost) and secure-config checklist (SECURITY.md:1-78). Stale: it says sync_service.py calls find via create_subprocess_exec (SECURITY.md:29-31) but no such module exists here; the only create_subprocess_exec is the optional external formatter (file_utils.py:263). A separate integrations/openclaw/SECURITY.md covers that plugin's auto-install of bm.

claim_checks.claim: Local-first and two-way: files are the source of truth and sync keeps humans and AI in step (README.md:39-40, 495-496).
claim_checks.evidence: Notes are Markdown in project dirs (default ~/basic-memory, src/basic_memory/config_models.py:910-916); the index DB is derived and bm reset deletes only the index (cli/commands/db.py:211-214; db.py:233-236). A watchfiles watcher starts in the MCP lifespan (index/watch_service.py:17; mcp/server.py:177-179), index_changes defaults true (config_models.py:558-561) and startup runs recovery plus a project index (services/initialization.py:266-303), but only while a Basic Memory process runs. Nuance: local writes are accepted DB-first and the file is written afterward (mcp/server.py:194-200; services/initialization.py:58-67; docs/DOMAIN_MODEL.md:131-148 says authority depends on write phase).

claim_checks.claim: Every tool is tagged with behavior hints (read-only, destructive, idempotent) (README.md:45-47, 397-400).
claim_checks.evidence: All 21 registered tools (mcp/tools/__init__.py:37-61) carry readOnlyHint and destructiveHint annotations (e.g. delete_note.py:188-193, write_note.py:61-67, read_note.py:66-67), but a grep of mcp/tools finds idempotentHint only in write_note.py:65 (False). README What's New also still says FastMCP 3.0 while pyproject.toml:32 pins fastmcp==4.0.0b1.

claim_checks.claim: Cloud is never required and the local install is 'Air-gapped friendly' (README.md:48, 80).
claim_checks.evidence: Cloud endpoints are only config defaults used at login (config_models.py:664-679); MCP startup reads a local token file only (mcp/server.py:138-152). But three defaults reach the network unless switched off: auto_update true -> PyPI check and uv/brew upgrade from stdio MCP sessions (config_models.py:696-705; cli/commands/mcp.py:85-99; auto_update.py:22, 119-130); semantic search on by default with a first-use FastEmbed model download (config_models.py:64-69, 252-255; docs/semantic-search.md:181); Umami events from interactive CLI (cli/analytics.py:28-29; promo.py:96-126). Each has an off switch (README.md:602-606; analytics.py:40-43; docs/semantic-search.md:30), so air-gapped use needs deliberate config plus a pre-seeded model cache (FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH, config_models.py:91-110) and pre-fetched uv/PyPI installs.

claim_checks.claim: Telemetry is minimal, anonymous, limited to promo/login events, and BASIC_MEMORY_NO_PROMOS=1 disables all telemetry (README.md:608-627).
claim_checks.evidence: Event names and call sites match the README list (cli/analytics.py:56-60; cloud/core_commands.py:80, 94, 99, 314; promo.py:126); payload is event name, BM version, trigger (analytics.py:79-93); the env var disables sending (analytics.py:40-43). Caveats: NO_PROMOS appears only in analytics.py and promo.py, so auto-update checks and Logfire are separate switches; bm cloud promo --off itself sends an opt-out event unless the env var is set (core_commands.py:303-315); 'no IP addresses' is not verifiable from the repo because each event is a direct HTTPS POST from the user's host (analytics.py:95-109).

claim_checks.claim: Auto-updates every 24 h, silently, for uv tool and Homebrew installs; skipped for uvx (README.md:382-383, 593-606).
claim_checks.evidence: auto_update defaults true and update_check_interval 86400 (config_models.py:696-705); install source detection (auto_update.py:68-79); uvx skipped (auto_update.py:280-288); upgrade runs uv tool upgrade basic-memory or brew upgrade basic-memory (auto_update.py:399-417); stdio MCP runs it silently in a daemon thread (cli/commands/mcp.py:85-99); unknown installs only get a notice (auto_update.py:365-377); config switch honored (auto_update.py:290-298).

claim_checks.claim: Claude Code plugin gives session briefings and pre-compaction checkpoints; the MCP server is a hard prerequisite because hooks and skills call it (README.md:209-225).
claim_checks.evidence: Hooks exist as described: SessionStart and PreCompact (plugins/claude-code/hooks/hooks.json:4-27); bm hook builds a fenced brief and writes an extractive checkpoint note (cli/commands/hook.py:590-729, 893-1003, 1054-1121); skills and output style are present (plugins/claude-code/). Imprecise: the hooks import and call search_notes/write_note in-process through the uv-resolved package (hook.py:463-477, 1099-1105; plugins/claude-code/README.md:76-78, 83-88), so only the skills need the MCP tools connected; the plugin bundles no .mcp.json (the Codex plugin does).

claim_checks.claim: Codex still requires approval for destructive-annotated Basic Memory tools (writes, edits, deletes) even with default_tools_approval_mode=approve (README.md:310-324).
claim_checks.evidence: Server side: write_note, edit_note, delete_note and delete_project advertise destructiveHint true (write_note.py:63-64; edit_note.py:354-357; delete_note.py:190-191; project_management.py:780-781); move_note and create_memory_project do not (move_note.py:355-356; project_management.py:547-548). Codex's approval behavior is host-defined and not checkable here. The Codex plugin bundles uvx basic-memory mcp without --project (plugins/codex/.mcp.json:3-9).

claim_checks.claim: Official agent packages are the core package, Claude Code plugin, shared skills, Hermes and OpenClaw plugins (README.md:190-192).
claim_checks.evidence: plugins/codex/ exists with manifest, hooks, skills, schemas and .mcp.json (plugins/codex/.codex-plugin/plugin.json:1-46), a marketplace entry (.agents/plugins/marketplace.json:6-19), a package-check-codex target (justfile:585, 597-599), a CI job (consolidated-packages.yml:47-58) and release version bumps (justfile:710-712). Root README omits it and only links its README in passing (README.md:323-324); AGENTS.md:68-79 also omits it; install steps are only in plugins/codex/README.md:101-108.

claim_checks.claim: Local snapshots and backups are 'Roll your own' (README.md:169) - i.e. the tool provides no local recovery.
claim_checks.evidence: delete_note is documented permanent and not undoable (mcp/tools/delete_note.py:264-266) and unlinks files (services/file_service.py:397-409); delete_project(delete_notes=True) and bm project remove --delete-notes rmtree the directory (services/project_service.py:410-416; cli/commands/project.py:871-876); snapshot and restore commands only call the Cloud API (cli/commands/cloud/snapshot.py:57-60; restore.py:69); no local export, trash, undelete or pre-migration DB backup exists (only a config.json.bak: config.py:129-134).

claim_checks.claim: Hook lifecycle capture is on by default, inspectable (bm hook status), archivable locally (bm hook flush) and never becomes graph notes (plugins/claude-code/README.md:94-98; plugins/codex/README.md:186-190).
claim_checks.evidence: Capture defaults on and needs JSON true (cli/commands/hook.py:78, 423); envelopes are strict, immutable, bounded metadata, one owner-only JSON file per event under ~/.basic-memory/inbox (hooks/envelope.py:61-79; hooks/inbox.py:40-47, 73-90); status prints inbox depth, last flush, settings and versions (hook.py:1475-1508); flush only moves valid envelopes to processed/, prunes after 30 days and writes no notes (hook.py:1159-1181; hooks/archive.py:1-6, 58-97). Caveats: Claude's PreCompact separately writes a real note (hook.py:1079-1121), Codex relies on agent-authored checkpoints, and flush is manual.

risks: No local recovery for deleted or overwritten memory: delete_note is permanent and unlinks files; delete_project(delete_notes=True) and bm project remove --delete-notes rmtree the project dir; snapshots/restore exist only in the paid Cloud; no local export, trash, undelete or pre-migration backup (mcp/tools/delete_note.py:264-266; services/file_service.py:397-409; services/project_service.py:410-416; cli/commands/cloud/snapshot.py:57-60; README.md:169). write_note overwrite=True and edit_note replace content in place; only Codex bm-checkpoint is immutable (plugins/codex/skills/bm-checkpoint/SKILL.md:61-79); 'archive, never delete' is skill guidance, not enforcement (skills/memory-lifecycle/SKILL.md:8). Destructive tools are exposed to every connected client unless the server runs with --project, which the shipped Codex .mcp.json and README snippets do not use (plugins/codex/.mcp.json:3-9). Recovery depends on external backups or git of the notes dir.

Durability model is DB-first, not purely file-first: a local write is accepted into the DB and the Markdown file is written afterward by in-process workers, with a shutdown drain and a startup recovery pass (mcp/server.py:194-200; services/initialization.py:52-67; config_models.py:497-504; docs/DOMAIN_MODEL.md:140-148). SQLite runs WAL with synchronous=NORMAL, so an OS crash can lose the last transactions (config_models.py:510-518). Claude and Codex would each run their own basic-memory mcp process plus short-lived bm hook processes against one shared SQLite DB and note tree (WAL, 10 s busy timeout: db.py:228-232); maintainers fixed production deadlock clusters and duplicate observations in v0.23.0 with CAS/generation fences (AGENTS.md:168-176; CHANGELOG.md:174-177, 243-248), and the concurrent-write benchmark treats divergence as a possible result (benchmarks/README.md:159-175); no published results.

Capture defaults are on and unattended: hook lifecycle envelopes (cwd, session id, project hint, model) record for both hosts unless the JSON boolean false is set (cli/commands/hook.py:78, 423; hooks/inbox.py:50-52) and pile up in ~/.basic-memory/inbox until an operator runs bm hook flush (no automatic scheduling found; archive pruned after 30 days: hooks/inbox.py:37, 155-157). Claude's PreCompact auto-writes an extractive note into the primary project with clipped user text (opening request up to 300 chars, last 3 user turns up to 200) and no content redaction (hook.py:893-1003, 1079-1121; redaction.py covers config values only; the hook redaction subsystem and detect-secrets were removed: CHANGELOG.md:371-372). Checkpoint frontmatter records username, hostname and cwd (plugins/claude-code/skills/bm-checkpoint/SKILL.md:63-70).

Self-changing defaults: auto_update is on (24 h); a stdio MCP session starts a background uv tool upgrade / brew upgrade for uv-tool and Homebrew installs (config_models.py:696-705; cli/commands/mcp.py:85-99; auto_update.py:399-417) and every start runs Alembic migrations automatically (28 migration files; v0.23.0 notes five auto-run migrations incl. a data-repair step: CHANGELOG.md:83-86; services/initialization.py:131-146) with no DB or notes backup first. Version skew is possible: the Codex plugin's MCP server is floating uvx basic-memory mcp while its hooks pin git tag v0.23.2 (plugins/codex/.mcp.json:4-8; plugins/codex/hooks/session_start.py:5); Claude hooks float at >=0.23.2 from PyPI (plugins/claude-code/hooks/session_start.py:5).

Pre-1.0 churn and heavy runtime: 0.x with breaking changes in minor releases (CHANGELOG.md:88-123; 13 changelog-listed releases from 2026-03-10 to 2026-08-25); the MCP server depends on an exact beta, fastmcp==4.0.0b1, and MCP SDK v2 (pyproject.toml:18, 32, 153; CHANGELOG.md:121-123); hook scripts re-pin the beta so older uv can resolve it (plugins/*/hooks/*.py:6-10); litellm is capped <1.92 for Python 3.14 (pyproject.toml:50-52). 43 direct runtime deps plus a HuggingFace model download on first semantic use; hooks need uv and network on first run (PyPI for Claude, GitHub git+https for Codex) under 20-120 s hook timeouts with silent fail-open (plugins/codex/README.md:97-99; plugins/*/hooks/hooks.json). No cold-start timing is published.

Unauthenticated network surface if HTTP transports are used: basic-memory mcp --transport streamable-http|sse defaults to host 0.0.0.0:8000 (cli/commands/mcp.py:28-32); the FastMCP server and FastAPI app configure no authentication (mcp/server.py:229-234; api/app.py:93-141); the Docker image CMD serves SSE on 0.0.0.0:8000 and docs publish the port (Dockerfile:52; docs/Docker.md:14-20). SECURITY.md scopes the product to single-user local use, stdio by default, REST on localhost (SECURITY.md:64-78).

Licensing and governance: core is AGPL-3.0-or-later (pyproject.toml:7) though README says AGPL-3.0 (README.md:689); plugins, skills and OpenClaw are declared MIT (plugins/claude-code/README.md:218; plugins/codex/.codex-plugin/plugin.json:12; skills/README.md:135; integrations/openclaw/package.json:8) without a LICENSE file under plugins/ or skills/, while the Hermes plugin is AGPL-3.0-or-later (integrations/hermes/README.md:239). The CLA assigns copyright to Basic Machines LLC, which may relicense contributions under any terms (CLA.md:29-33). Single-vendor project with a paid cloud; the OSS CLI shows cloud promos in interactive sessions (cli/promo.py:36-45, 96-126).

Release and CI assurance gaps plus doc drift: no checksum, signature or provenance step for PyPI artifacts, GitHub release assets or the ghcr.io image (only the OpenClaw npm package uses --provenance: release.yml:44-57, 95; docker.yml:50-59); release.yml still passes secrets.PYPI_TOKEN while dev-release.yml says it no longer exists (release.yml:54-57; dev-release.yml:74-77); Actions are pinned to mutable tags; dependabot.yml has an empty package-ecosystem (.github/dependabot.yml:8); tests run on push only with no coverage gate and the plugin hook tests are not run by CI; plugin packaging is validated statically, not against real Claude Code or Codex (consolidated-packages.yml; plugins/*/justfile). Stale docs: SECURITY.md cites a non-existent sync_service.py (SECURITY.md:29-31); README says FastMCP 3.0 and 'v0.18 -> v0.20' (README.md:397, 404); Claude plugin docs say Basic Memory >=0.19.0 (plugins/claude-code/docs/getting-started.md:9) while the hook floor is 0.23.2.
